dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's great! I don't have to worry about the wind or rain, or where my next meal is coming from — and the scenery is amazing! Thanks for inviting me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm glad you like it.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're so nice! Can I ask a teeny tiny favor, though?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ask away.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Is it okay if I set up camp here? I'll find a spot that's out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? So... you don't like your room?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: No, no, no, it's lovely! Everything's so comfy and cozy, the bed's warm and dry, and it smells nice too. It's so much nicer than the rooms at The Flagship, I'll tell you that...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's just... Ah, well, they say it's easy to go from rags to riches, but much harder to go back again.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If I get used to this life, I'm worried I won't be able to return to living off the land...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: What if I find myself dreaming about this fluffy bed while I'm deep in the mountains? I'm not sure I could cope!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: For someone like me, I think it's best to maintain a healthy hunger for the finer things in life.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That way, I can make sure my senses are sharp while never losing the drive and excitement to pursue what I want.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: For me, that's the crux of living.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see, so that's your survival strategy...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Indeed! So, if it's alright with you, I'd like to set up my own camp somewhere out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Out of interest, have you ever stopped to listen to the music of the night? The nighttime wilds are far from silent, and thickets that appear like shadows are actually hives of nocturnal activity.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Some insects only sing when moonlight bathes the stage, chirping and chiming one after another as if following some mysterious tune.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Listening to them sing is fascinating. If that sounds like something you'd like to hear, feel free to drop by my camp sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Or we can just lie there and gaze at the stars. That would be nice too...
